title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 4, 2026, relative to City Council File No. 25-0696 –
text:
[4. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 4, 2026, relative to City Council File No. 25-0696 –
  Operational Impacts of the Proposed Less Lethal Ordinance, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-341] [CityOrdinance]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s Report and TRANSMIT to City Council.
summary: The department's assessment of the operational impacts of a proposed less lethal ordinance now before the City Council. The Police Commission is asked to approve the report and send it to the City Council.

flag.reason: Police Commission's assessment of a less lethal weapons ordinance pending before Council, a citywide public safety policy.
